description: Korean VAT credits (부가가치세법, 2026): mode deemed = deemed input tax on untaxed farm and fishery purchases (조특법·부가세법 제42조: individual restaurants 9/109 up to KRW 200M tax base else 8/108, corporate restaurants and bakeries 6/106, SME manufacturers 4/104, others 2/102) with the limit ratio of the tax base; mode card = credit-card sales credit 1.3% up to KRW 10M a year for individuals with prior-year supply ≤ 1 billion (제46조); mode bad-debt = bad-debt credit 10/110 and the last period to claim (10 years after supply). The 2027 government proposal (1.2%, 5M) is not law yet.

cardSales.description: card: card and cash-receipt sales including VAT

confirmed.description: bad-debt: date the bad debt was confirmed

payable.description: card: VAT payable before this credit

purchases.description: deemed: purchases of untaxed farm/fishery products

taxBase.description: deemed: VAT tax base (supply value) for the period

usedThisYear.description: card: credit already used this year
